request: Build a small Jac web app that manages a roster of users. Each user has a name and a username. A visitor can add a user, edit a user's name and username in place, and delete a user. Usernames are unique, ignoring case. Keep the roster logic in a reusable service.
acceptance: Add, edit and delete users from the page.
A second user with the same username in different case is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
